inclusion_rule: Include studies that convert whispered, non-audible-murmur or other unvoiced or alaryngeal speech captured acoustically or by body conduction into voiced, normal-sounding speech audio, and classify how the converter is supervised: time-aligned whisper-normal pairs (parallel, DTW), unpaired or non-parallel data, or synthetic whisper made from normal speech.
